description: Core webview permissions, plus the updater plugin. DR Companion's own commands (detection, bridge install, always-on-top) are app commands and are not granted here; apart from the updater, no plugin is given shell, filesystem or network access. `updater:default` grants check, download, install and downloadAndInstall - the plugin has no finer split, so the restraint has to be in the app: src/lib/updater.ts never calls downloadAndInstall, never installs without an explicit press, and never installs during a live game session without a confirmation.
